summary: The hybrid unsupported-resume gate is bound to the frozen plan identity; cached-list drift cannot bypass save/load or reach raw methods, and all scoped regressions pass.
residual_conditions: This PASS authorizes preparation only of a separate exact native-five-step package; it does not authorize hardware execution.
The package must preserve the proposal command, unique label, protected hashes, model-only final.pt contract, fresh-start lifecycle, and explicit human/operator authorization.
Hybrid optimizer serialization/resume remains deliberately unsupported; any interruption requires a new unique-label run from step zero.
